headlines.title: China’s debt ratio dips as households cut borrowing and firms slash investment: report
headlines.summary:
China’s debt-to-GDP ratio fell in the second quarter for the first time since 2022, even as the government kept borrowing while households and private companies pulled back under the weight of falling home prices, sluggish income growth and shrinking profit margins, according to a new report.
The ratio slipped 1.1 percentage points to 308.2 per cent, the National Institution for Finance and Development (NIFD), a Beijing-based think tank, said in a quarterly report on Thursday.

headlines.title_zh: 中国债务比率回落，家庭减少借贷、企业削减投资：报告
headlines.summary_zh: 最新报告显示，尽管政府持续借贷，但家庭和企业因房价下跌、收入增长乏力及利润空间收窄而减少借贷，中国第二季度债务与国内生产总值之比自2022年以来首次下降。该比率下降1.1个百分点，至308.2%。

headlines.title_en: General Administration of Customs: Zero-tariff policy has been implemented for 63 countries so far
headlines.summary_en: GACC data today shows that in the first seven months of this year, China's bulk commodity imports rose 3% year on year, including an 8.2% increase in metal ore imports. During the same period, imports of mechanical and electrical products totaled 5.31 trillion yuan, up 29.7%, accounting for 41.9% of total imports. China is actively expanding independent opening-up, voluntarily increasing imports to promote balanced trade. To date, zero-tariff policies have been implemented for 63 countries, and import scale has ranked second globally for 17 consecutive years. (CCTV News)

headlines.title: 美国设置多晶硅底价较国内价格高出约3.4倍 抬升海外加工产能输美的综合成本
headlines.summary: 据国投期货，美国对进口多晶硅及其衍生产品实施最低进口价格及额外关税措施。多晶硅最低进口价21美元/公斤，折合约14.2万元/吨；当前国内N型致密料均价约3.2万元/吨，美国设置的进口底价较国内价格高出约3.4倍。多晶硅、硅锭晶圆、电池、组件全品类均需满足对应档位的最低进口价格门槛。本次新增全链条最低进口价格机制，抹平海外产品成本优势。规则面向全部进口来源，并非单独针对中国，配合反规避监管，重点压缩第三国套利空间，抬升海外加工产能输美的综合成本。

headlines.title_en: US sets polysilicon floor price roughly 3.4 times higher than domestic price, raising comprehensive costs for overseas processing capacity exports to the US
headlines.summary_en: According to Guotou Futures, the U.S. imposed minimum import prices and additional tariffs on imported polysilicon and derivative products. The minimum polysilicon import price is $21/kg, roughly 142,000 yuan/ton; the current domestic average price for N-type dense material is about 32,000 yuan/ton, making the U.S. import floor about 3.4 times higher than domestic prices. Polysilicon, ingots, wafers, cells, and modules all must meet corresponding minimum import price thresholds. This new full-chain minimum price mechanism erases overseas cost advantages. The rules apply to all import sources, not just China, and combined with anti-circumvention oversight, mainly compress third-country arbitrage space and raise the overall cost of overseas processing capacity exporting to the U.S.

headlines.title_en: China's foreign trade import and export scale exceeds 4 trillion yuan for 5 consecutive months
headlines.summary_en: GACC data released on the 7th shows that in July, foreign trade maintained the strong growth trend from H1, with total imports and exports of 4.66 trillion yuan, exceeding 4 trillion yuan for five consecutive months, up 19.2% year on year, including exports up 17.8% and imports up 21.2%. By cumulative growth, first-seven-month imports and exports reached 30.13 trillion yuan, up 17.3% year on year, with exports at 17.44 trillion yuan, up 14%, and imports at 12.69 trillion yuan, up 22%. (Xinhua)

headlines.summary_en: GACC data released today shows that in the first seven months of this year, China's goods trade imports and exports totaled 30.13 trillion yuan, up 17.3% year on year, sustaining a good growth trend. headlines.summary: 从签约企业处获悉，8月6日晚，在7月31日市场监管总局对光伏行业开展价格合规指导后仅一周，国内八大多晶硅企业在上海共同签署反内卷《倡议书》。八家企业合计占据国内多晶硅有效产能超过90%，包括四家上市公司通威股份、协鑫科技、大全能源、新特能源，以及亚洲硅业（青海）股份有限公司、新疆东方希望新能源有限公司、青海丽豪清能股份有限公司、新疆戈恩斯能源科技有限公司。

headlines.title_en: Eight major polysilicon giants sign initiative: no sales below cost price
headlines.summary_en: Learned from signing companies that on the evening of August 6, just one week after the SAMR conducted price compliance guidance for the photovoltaic industry on July 31, eight major domestic polysilicon enterprises jointly signed an anti-involution 'Initiative' in Shanghai. The eight companies account for over 90% of domestic effective polysilicon capacity, including four listed companies Tongwei, GCL Tech, Daqo Energy, and Xinte Energy, as well as Asia Silicon (Qinghai) Co., Ltd., Xinjiang East Hope New Energy Co., Ltd., Qinghai Lihao Clean Energy Co., Ltd., and Xinjiang Goens Energy Technology Co., Ltd.

headlines.title: 国家统计局：今年前7个月我国出口机电产品11.12万亿元，增长21.2%
headlines.summary: 今年前7个月，我国出口机电产品11.12万亿元，增长21.2%，占我国整体出口的63.8%，比去年同期提升了3.8个百分点。其中：电动汽车、锂电池、风力发电机组等绿色低碳产品分别增长71.2%，35.8%，34.8%。3D打印机、工业机器人、船舶分别出口112亿元、73.4亿元、2681.4亿元，分别增长1.1倍、13.2%、32.7%。

headlines.title_en: National Bureau of Statistics: In the first 7 months of this year, China exported 11.12 trillion yuan of mechanical and electrical products, up 21.2%
headlines.summary_en: In the first seven months of this year, China's exports of mechanical and electrical products reached 11.12 trillion yuan, up 21.2%, accounting for 63.8% of total exports, up 3.8 percentage points from a year earlier. Among them, green and low-carbon products such as EVs, lithium batteries, and wind power generators rose 71.2%, 35.8%, and 34.8%, respectively. Exports of 3D printers, industrial robots, and ships were 11.2 billion yuan, 7.34 billion yuan, and 268.14 billion yuan, up 110%, 13.2%, and 32.7%, respectively.

headlines.title_en: August 7 midday close: ChiNext Index up 1.75% in half-day, innovative drugs and PCB concept stocks collectively firm
headlines.summary_en: 1. Markets strengthened with volatile trading in the morning, led by ChiNext. Innovative drug and CRO concept stocks rallied, with over a dozen stocks hitting limit-up including Bide Pharmatech, GemPharmatech, and Sino Biological. PCB concepts extended gains, with multiple stocks hitting limit-up such as Taijin New Energy, Yibo Technology, and Huazheng New Materials. Rare earth permanent magnet concepts were active, with China Rare Earth hitting limit-up. 6G concepts remained strong, Wuhan Fangu 2 consecutive limit-ups, Tongyu Communication 4 limit-ups in 5 days. On the downside, information security concepts fell, with Riseinfo and Nsfocus down over 8%. More stocks fell than rose, with over 3,000 stocks in the red across Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing markets; morning turnover was 1.69 trillion yuan. At midday close, the Shanghai Composite rose 0.49%, Shenzhen Component rose 1.31%, and ChiNext rose 1.75%. 2. By sector concept, innovative drugs, CRO, PCB, and CPO led gains; cross-border payment, digital currency, diversified finance, and software development led losses. 3
